issue.title: [YSQL] pg15-upgrade: YB master postgres webserver port collision

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-13638](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-13638)
### Description

Steps to repro:
Prep: Wait for #24545 to be fixed, or patch a fix for it first.
1. On MacOS 14 arm64 (but probably happens on a dev server as well), run `./yb_build.sh`, to get a debug build.
2. `pg15_tests/test_upgrade.sh`
3. Look for the postgresql log in the master node, possibly `/tmp/pg15_cluster_data/node-1/disk-1/yb-data/master/logs/postgresql-*.log`

EXPECTED
Log contains no lines indicating a failure to start the webserver

RESULT
```
I1023 18:36:23.244083 4284616512 webserver.cc:348] Webserver listen spec is 127.0.0.200:13000
I1023 18:36:23.244236 4284616512 webserver.cc:558] Webserver: set_ports_option: cannot bind to 127.0.0.200:13000: 48 (Address already in use)
```
This is because the tserver on 127.0.0.200 (or whatever node is the master leader in your case) has already taken port 13000. The master's upgrade postgres either needs its own port, or to not start a webserver.

### Issue Type

kind/bug

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-13639](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-13639)
### Description

Steps to repro:
Prep: Wait for #24545 to be fixed, or patch a fix for it first.
1. On MacOS 14 arm64 (but probably happens on a dev server as well), run `./yb_build.sh`, to get a debug build.
2. `pg15_tests/test_upgrade.sh`
3. Look for the postgresql log in the master node, possibly `/tmp/pg15_cluster_data/node-1/disk-1/yb-data/master/logs/postgresql-*.log`

EXPECTED
Log contains no FailedAssertion lines

RESULT
Many instances of:
```
TRAP: FailedAssertion("IsYugaByteEnabled()", File: "../../../../../../../src/postgres/src/backend/utils/error/elog.c", Line: 4501, PID: 99651)
0   postgres                            0x0000000103866060 ExceptionalCondition + 276
1   postgres                            0x00000001038707b8 yb_errmsg_from_status + 624
2   yb_pg_metrics.so                    0x00000001042989c8 webserver_worker_main + 1428
3   postgres                            0x000000010348ea80 StartBackgroundWorker + 768
4   postgres                            0x00000001034a46c0 do_start_bgworker + 804
5   postgres                            0x000000010349b2fc maybe_start_bgworkers + 544
6   postgres                            0x00000001034972f4 PostmasterMain + 9092
7   postgres                            0x00000001033398b8 startup_hacks + 0
8   postgres                            0x0000000103339e14 main + 36
9   dyld                                0x0000000197447154 start + 2476
```

This bug probably depends on #24601 to be broken. But it seems like the assertion should be removed, or possibly switched to `YBIsEnabledInPostgresEnvVar`.

body:
Consider the following scenario:

(1) Universe with Packed Row feature on.
(2) A packed row with initial values is inserted.
(3) Update one of the columns of the row in (2) - This is stored in unpacked form.
(4) Packed Row is turned off on the universe/tserver.
(5) After the history retention interval (default 15 minutes), when compaction runs, it tries to repack the row (Even though Packed Row feature is off, since the base row was compacted). This can lead to the crash.
